title: elettariopsis monophylla
intro: Elettariopsis monophylla, commonly known as Lesser Galangal, is a type of plant belonging to the ginger family (Zingiberaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and combat fever. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Galangal include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating a range of health issues. The bioactive constituents of Elettariopsis monophylla include gingerols, shogaols, and other compounds that have been shown to have potent biological activities.
